note_retry.answer:
**Volunteer Note: One Name for Our Seeds**

Volunteers, our heirloom seed collection has been catalogued under the codename SEEDLOCK-ecaff17d. Please use that reference whenever you check out packets, label a return, or log a new donation at the library table. Keeping one consistent name helps our tallies stay accurate and our shelves findable through the busy planting season. Thanks for your steady hands.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)

conclusion:
**Seed Library Update: Counted, Catalogued, and Ready**

Volunteers, our seed-library tally is complete: 16 trays of 31 packets each came to exactly 496 seed packets on the shelf. Every tray was counted and verified, with none missing or duplicated. Our heirloom collection is now catalogued under the codename SEEDLOCK-ecaff17d, and we ask that you use that exact reference whenever you check out packets, label a return, or log a new donation. Keeping one consistent name keeps our tallies accurate and our shelves findable through the busy planting season. Thank you for your steady hands.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)
